tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The field of the app icon. The brand's deep blue: covers, splash, store art. White (`on-brand`) reads on it at 7.3:1. Not a UI surface inside the app.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: The chevron over the g in the app icon; the same value as the light theme's `accent`. Pair it with `brand-blue`, never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: The g of the app icon; text and marks on `brand-blue`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything: panels, the tab bar, the staff area (egui `panel_fill`, gray 248 / 27).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets (settings card, options sheet, More list) and button backgrounds; they share one fill (egui `inactive.weak_bg_fill`, gray 230 / 50).

tokens.name: card-hover
tokens.usage: A card cell or button under the pointer or finger (egui `hovered.weak_bg_fill`, gray 220 / 64).

tokens.name: control-active
tokens.usage: A plain egui button while pressed (egui `active.weak_bg_fill`, gray 165 / 40).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text-edit fields and the round side buttons beside play (edit, new rhythm, share) (egui `extreme_bg_color`, gray 255 / 10).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the panel separator over the tab bar, the divider in a split row, window outlines (egui `noninteractive.bg_stroke`, gray 190 / 60). Decorative only: 1.4:1 on `card` in light.

tokens.name: control-border-hover
tokens.usage: Outline of a hovered egui button or window edge (egui `hovered.bg_stroke`).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and row labels on `panel` and `card` (light 6.5:1 on card; dark lifted from egui's gray 140 to 200 by `readable_text` for 7.7:1 on card).

tokens.name: text-button
tokens.usage: Text of a resting egui button on `card` (egui `inactive.fg_stroke`; dark lifted to gray 200 by `readable_text`).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Values in the settings card (tempo, bars, meter), side-button icons, pressed button text (egui `strong_text_color`).

tokens.name: text-weak
tokens.usage: Card cell labels, a row's current value and chevron, unselected tabs, the sheet handle; on `panel` and `card` (light 5.1:1 on card, dark 5.5:1). Set by `readable_text` because egui's own weak text was 2.3 to 2.9:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the play button, a switch that is on and a selected button (egui `selection.bg_fill`). Not a text color: put `accent-text` on it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The selected tab's icon and label on `panel`, the play icon on `accent`, the text cursor (egui `selection.stroke`). Light 7.8:1 on panel, 5.0:1 on accent; dark 12.4:1 on panel, 5.3:1 on accent.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Edit and playback cursors, the count label being played and a lit note on the staff. The selection blues sit too close to the notes, so light takes a vivid blue and dark yellow. Light 4.4:1 on panel: a mark, not body text.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Track of a switch that is off; light needs a gray so the white knob shows. Light 1.5:1 on card, dark 1.5:1: the knob position, not the track, says off, so keep the label beside it.

tokens.name: switch-knob
tokens.usage: The knob of a switch, on and off, in both themes.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: The BETA pill on a tab or settings row: orange, the same in both themes. Only for a not-yet-finished feature.

tokens.name: on-badge
tokens.usage: Text in the `badge` pill. 3.5:1, below 4.5:1 for its 9–12px text: kept as the source has it; a fix would darken `badge`.

tokens.name: ring-idle
tokens.usage: Metronome ring segments that are not playing; deliberately between `panel` and `ring-lit` (2.1:1 / 2.5:1 on panel) so the lit one stands out.

tokens.name: ring-lit
tokens.usage: The ring segment of the click being played: a saturated blue that differs from `ring-idle` by lightness and hue (4.3:1 / 7.5:1 on panel).

tokens.name: grade-perfect
tokens.usage: Play-along mark for a hit on time. Blue, orange/yellow and purple stay apart for red-green and blue-yellow deficiencies; each grade also has its own shape.

tokens.name: grade-good
tokens.usage: Play-along mark for a hit slightly early or late. Light 2.6:1 on panel, below 3:1 for a mark: the shape still tells it apart; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: grade-off
tokens.usage: Play-along mark for a hit far off (with an arrowhead) and for a miss (a cross).

tokens.name: flash
tokens.usage: The flash over the staff on each click when the flash is on; drawn at up to 80% opacity and fading out.

tokens.name: grade-reference
tokens.usage: A note's zero line and the connector from it to the hit.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: egui hyperlinks in help text. Light 2.8:1 on panel: the source's egui default, too faint for text; prefer `accent-text` for new links.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: egui warning text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: egui error text.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of inline code in egui text.

tokens.name: site-bg
tokens.usage: Guide pages (grooph.app guides): page background.

tokens.name: site-surface
tokens.usage: Guide pages: header, footer and rhythm figure background.

tokens.name: site-text
tokens.usage: Guide pages: body text on `site-bg` and `site-surface`.

tokens.name: site-muted
tokens.usage: Guide pages: breadcrumbs, captions, footer, tuplet brackets (5.0:1 / 6.0:1 on `site-bg`).

tokens.name: site-line
tokens.usage: Guide pages: header and footer rules, table rows, rhythm-grid cell lines.

tokens.name: site-accent
tokens.usage: Guide pages: links, the focus/hover outline of a button, the accent ring on an accented note.

tokens.name: site-accent-bg
tokens.usage: Guide pages: fill of the call-to-action button and of an accented note's halo; `site-text` on it.

tokens.name: site-note
tokens.usage: Guide pages: a note dot in the rhythm grid.

tokens.name: site-rest
tokens.usage: Guide pages: a rest bar and its syllable in the rhythm grid; dim by design.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog and section headings: egui Heading 18 + the app's font bump of 8.

styles.name: card-value
styles.usage: A value in the settings card, in `text-strong`; shrinks to fit its cell.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: New bars keep coming in endless mode.
styles.usage: Body and button text: egui Body and Button 13 + 8.

styles.name: row-label
styles.usage: Label of a value or switch row in `text`, and the row's current value in `text-weak`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: egui Small 9 + 8: hints under controls.

styles.name: theme-choice
styles.usage: The three theme buttons in the More list; shrinks to fit 76px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Card cell labels and tab labels, in `text-weak` (or `accent-text` for the selected tab).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: The badge pill in a settings row.

styles.name: badge-tab
styles.usage: The BETA pill over a tab icon.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: egui Monospace 13 + 8: links and notation text.

styles.name: meter-tile
styles.usage: Time signatures in the meter picker's tiles (SMuFL time-signature digits).

styles.name: meter-card
styles.usage: The meter in the settings card: its two stacked digits are this high.

styles.name: staff-preview
styles.usage: Rhythm previews in the library list.

styles.name: staff
styles.usage: Notation on the staff: the default em, scaled with the staff's room.

styles.name: site-h1
styles.usage: Guide page title; 27px under 640px wide.

styles.name: site-h2
styles.usage: Guide section heading.

styles.name: site-brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the guide header, set in type.

styles.name: site-h3
styles.usage: Guide sub-heading.

styles.name: site-body
styles.sample: Practice rhythm reading and timing in your browser.
styles.usage: Guide body text in `site-text`.

styles.name: site-small
styles.usage: Tables, captions, footer.

styles.name: site-crumbs
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs and rhythm-grid syllables in `site-muted`.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tool palette grid gap; gap between the theme buttons; card inner margin across.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner margin top and bottom; card cell value inset from the bottom.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a row label and its badge; card cell label inset from the top.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Window margin of egui dialogs.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page inset around cards and sheets; transport gap between cells.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Button padding, both axes (egui `button_padding`).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Guide pages: header and main side padding.

tokens.name: radius-tool
tokens.usage: Tool palette buttons in the editor.

tokens.name: radius-handle
tokens.usage: The 40×5 sheet handle bar.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Non-interactive egui frames.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: egui buttons, menus and windows; the guide pages' call-to-action button.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Guide pages: the rhythm figure.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a settings card cell.

tokens.name: radius-switch
tokens.usage: The 52×30 switch track (half its height).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets: the settings card, options sheet, More list (`CARD_RADIUS`). A raised sheet rounds only its top corners.

tokens.name: tab-height

tokens.name: card-cell-height
tokens.usage: A cell of the settings card.

tokens.name: tool-button

tokens.usage: Widest the controls column gets; wider windows center it.

shadow.note: egui shadows: offset, blur, no spread, black at alpha 25 (light) or 96 (dark).
